title: Joanna Fletcher (JFLETCHER)
summary: IT owner and administrator responsible for Ledgerline ERP 7.2 service definitions across Accounts Payable, Inventory, and Admin modules.

infobox.Name: Joanna Fletcher
infobox.Responsibilities: Ledgerline ERP 7.2 Service Registry and Gateway Service Ownership

body:
Joanna Fletcher (`JFLETCHER`) is an IT administrator and service owner at Northbridge Cycles responsible for maintaining and cataloguing the Ledgerline ERP 7.2 service registry[^r5][^r7][^r8]. Following the departure of [[user-dramsden|Derek Ramsden]] in 2012, she assumed IT ownership of key Accounts Payable SOAP gateway service definitions[^r6][^r31][^r32]. On 26 October 2026, she executed the registry export of Ledgerline 7.2 service definitions across the Accounts Payable, Inventory, and System Administration modules[^r1][^r55][^r105].

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| User ID | JFLETCHER[^r1][^r4] |
| Full Name | Joanna Fletcher[^r2][^r4] |
| Department | IT[^r5][^r7] |
| Predecessor | [[user-dramsden|Derek Ramsden (DRAMSDEN)]][^r6][^r36] |
| System Scope | Ledgerline ERP 7.2 Service Registry[^r1][^r4] |

## Responsibilities and System Ownership

Joanna Fletcher serves as the documented IT owner for core Ledgerline SOAP gateway service definitions, succeeding [[user-dramsden|Derek Ramsden]][^r5][^r9][^r34]. Her verified ownership encompasses Accounts Payable bank services (`bnk_block`, `bnk_get`, `bnk_save`, `bnk_search`, and `bnk_verify`) managed via [[services-ap-bnk|AP bnk services]] and [[screen-ap-bnk-06|AP-BNK-06]][^r5][^r6][^r7][^r8][^r9]. She also maintains ownership of payment gateway services (`pay_approve`, `pay_cancel`, `pay_file`, `pay_get`, `pay_propose`, `pay_release`, and `pay_search`) associated with [[services-ap-pay|AP pay services]], [[screen-ap-pay-03|AP-PAY-03]], and [[errors-pay|Errors PAY]][^r31][^r32][^r33][^r34][^r35][^r36][^r37].

## Service Registry Exports

On 26 October 2026, Fletcher exported Ledgerline ERP 7.2 service definitions from the central service registry across multiple functional domains[^r2][^r21][^r55]:

* **Accounts Payable**: Definitions for accruals (`acr_get`)[^r1], supplier advances (`adv_adjust`, `adv_get`, `adv_search`)[^r2][^r3][^r4], credit notes (`crn_get`, `crn_post`, `crn_save`, `crn_search`) linked to [[services-ap-crn|AP crn services]] and [[screen-ap-crn-05|AP-CRN-05]][^r10][^r11][^r12][^r13], currency tables (`cur_list`, `cur_save`)[^r14][^r15], debit notes (`dbn_cancel`, `dbn_save`, `dbn_search`)[^r16][^r17][^r18], employee expenses (`exp_approve`, `exp_get`, `exp_pay`, `exp_save`, `exp_search`) linked to [[services-ap-exp|AP exp services]] and [[screen-ap-exp-09|AP-EXP-09]][^r19][^r20][^r21][^r22][^r23], general ledger reversals (`gl_reverse`)[^r24], invoice processing (`inv_hold`, `inv_search`)[^r25][^r26], three-way matching (`mat_get`, `mat_override`, `mat_run`, `mat_search`) linked to [[services-ap-mat|AP mat services]] and [[screen-ap-mat-02|AP-MAT-02]][^r27][^r28][^r29][^r30], petty cash transactions (`pcs_get`, `pcs_post`, `pcs_save`, `pcs_search`)[^r38][^r39][^r40][^r41], period controls (`per_close`, `per_list`, `per_open`, `per_status`) linked to [[services-ap-per|AP per services]] and [[screen-ap-per-11|AP-PER-11]][^r42][^r43][^r44][^r45], supplier balance reporting (`sbal_ageing`, `sbal_query`, `sbal_stmt`)[^r46][^r47][^r48], supplier payment holds (`sup_pay_hold`, `sup_pay_release`)[^r49][^r50], tax codes (`tax_save`)[^r51], and VAT accounting (`vat_get`, `vat_rc_list`, `vat_run`)[^r52][^r53][^r54].
* **System Administration**: Definitions for API key maintenance (`api_key_list`, `api_key_revoke`)[^r55][^r56], audit trail queries (`aud_query`)[^r57], budget entries (`bud_query`, `bud_save`)[^r58][^r59], cost centre management (`cc_close`)[^r60], configuration parameters (`cfg_get`, `cfg_save`)[^r61][^r62], approval delegations (`dlg_cancel`, `dlg_get`, `dlg_list`, `dlg_save`) supporting [[screen-sys-dlg-03|SYS-DLG-03]][^r63][^r64][^r65][^r66], import staging (`imp_upload`)[^r67], background job execution (`job_cancel`, `job_list`, `job_log`, `job_schedule`, `job_status`, `job_submit`) linked to [[services-adm-job|ADM job services]] and [[screen-sys-job-06|SYS-JOB-06]][^r68][^r69][^r70][^r71][^r72][^r73], licensing (`lic_status`)[^r74], notifications (`ntf_queue_list`, `ntf_tpl_get`, `ntf_tpl_save`)[^r75][^r76][^r77], operating units (`ou_get`, `ou_list`, `ou_save`)[^r78][^r79][^r80], system parameters (`par_get`, `par_hist`, `par_list`, `par_set`) supporting [[services-adm-par|ADM par services]] and [[screen-sys-par-04|SYS-PAR-04]][^r81][^r82][^r83][^r84], printing templates (`prt_form_get`, `prt_list`)[^r85][^r86], RBAC definitions (`role_get`, `role_list`, `role_svc_add`, `role_svc_remove`)[^r87][^r88][^r89][^r90], number sequences (`seq_list`, `seq_set`)[^r91][^r92], session monitoring (`ses_kill`, `ses_list`)[^r93][^r94], system diagnostics (`sys_health`, `sys_ping`, `sys_version`)[^r95][^r96][^r97], and user account administration (`usr_create`, `usr_disable`, `usr_lock`, `usr_pwd_reset`, `usr_search`, `usr_unlock`, `usr_update`) linked to [[services-adm-usr|ADM usr services]], [[screen-sys-usr-01|SYS-USR-01]], and [[errors-usr|ERR-USR Error Codes]][^r98][^r99][^r100][^r101][^r102][^r103][^r104].
* **Inventory**: Definitions for inventory adjustments (`adj_approve`, `adj_cancel`, `adj_get`, `adj_post`, `adj_save`, `adj_search`) mapped to [[services-inv-adj|INV adj services]], [[screen-inv-adj-05|INV-ADJ-05]], and [[errors-adj|Stock Adjustment Error Codes (ERR-ADJ-*)]][^r105][^r106][^r107][^r108][^r109][^r110], warehouse bin records (`bin_block`, `bin_get`, `bin_search`)[^r111][^r112][^r113], cycle count planning and counting (`ccp_get`, `ccp_save`, `ccp_search`, `cnt_cancel`, `cnt_freeze`, `cnt_get`, `cnt_post`, `cnt_save`) supporting [[services-inv-cnt|INV cnt services]] and [[screen-inv-cnt-06|INV-CNT-06]][^r114][^r115][^r116][^r117][^r118][^r119][^r120][^r121], consignment inventory (`csg_save`, `csg_search`)[^r122][^r123], goods receipt notes (`grn_get`, `grn_save`, `grn_search`)[^r124][^r125][^r126], item master records (`itm_block`, `itm_save`, `itm_update`) linked to [[errors-itm|ERR-ITM error codes]][^r127][^r128][^r129], kanban signals (`kbn_get`, `kbn_save`, `kbn_signal`)[^r130][^r131][^r132], lot and serial number tracking (`lot_get`, `lot_hold`, `lot_release`, `lot_save`, `lot_search`, `lot_trace`) supporting [[services-inv-lot|INV lot services]] and [[screen-inv-lot-10|INV-LOT-10]][^r133][^r134][^r135][^r136][^r137][^r138], and material return notes (`mrn_get`, `mrn_post`)[^r139][^r140].

## Versions and conflicts

* **IT Ownership of AP Gateway Services**: Joanna Fletcher (`JFLETCHER`) is documented as the current IT owner of Ledgerline SOAP gateway service definitions (`bnk_*` and `pay_*`)[^r5][^r7][^r31][^r36]. Older service files record Derek Ramsden (`DRAMSDEN`) as the prior owner until his departure from Northbridge Cycles in 2012, at which point ownership transferred to Fletcher (`superseded`)[^r6][^r8][^r32][^r35].
